metadata.title: बस्तर में माओवादी ठिकाना तबाह | आदिवासी न्यूज़ राउंडअप | Big setback for Maoists in Bastar
metadata.description: In this week's bulletin,  Security forces have destroyed a major Maoist stronghold in the dense forests of Narayanpur-Kanker districts in Chhattisgarh, followed by a tragic bus accident in Tripura. Next, we'll address the shameful incident in Manipur where women were stripped and paraded, causing nationwide outrage.Then, we'll touch upon the issue of extensive tree cutting in the Hasdeo Arand forest of Chhattisgarh. Lastly, we'll also cover the significance of the Bharuch constituency in Gujarat. Stay tuned for these updates!
